stories.title: College football's time warp: Inside the complexities of clock management
stories.summary: From Michigan-WMU to Notre Dame-BYU, the closing seconds of games seem to be more puzzling than ever.

stories.title: Ravens send Humphrey home, say he'll be inactive Sunday for 'criminals' comment
stories.summary: The Ravens have sent cornerback Marlon Humphrey home from the facility, and he will be inactive for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

stories.title: Belichick, Kraft finalists once again for Pro Football Hall of Fame
stories.summary: Bill Belichick and Robert Kraft have both advanced to the final round of voting for the Pro Football Hall of Fame for the second straight year.

stories.title: Reigning champion UCLA lands Wilson Manyacka, No. 2 prospect in 2027 SC Next 100
stories.summary: Ivanna Wilson Manyacka, the No. 2 prospect in the 2027 SC Next 100, is signing with defending champion UCLA.

stories.title: New blood test has potential to detect CTE in the living, studies find
stories.summary: A new blood test shows potential to detect advanced stages of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) in the living, according to two recent published studies.
